outgoing.name: Africa
outgoing.excerpt: Antelopes are a polyphyletic group of herbivorous African and Asian animals of the family Bovidae, distinguished by a pair of hollow horns on their heads.

outgoing.name: Cattle
outgoing.excerpt: The term is used loosely to describe all members of the family Bovidae who do not fall under the category of sheep, cattle or goats.

outgoing.name: United States
